raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Allow NIXL UCX to reuse `--disaggregation-ib-device` for shared or per-GPU NIC selection. This makes GPU-to-NIC mappings configurable through the existing disaggregation option, without requiring separate backend configuration for each rank. ## Modifications - Resolve single-device, comma-separated, and per-GPU JSON/file mappings into NIXL UCX's `device_list`. - Validate device names and reject conflicting CLI and backend settings. - Preserve existing device selection when the option is unset; leave Mooncake and other NIXL backends unchanged. Example: ```bash --disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl \ --disaggregation-ib-device '{"0":"mlx5_0","1":"mlx5_1","2":"mlx5_2","3":"mlx5_3"}' ``` Mapping keys are process-visible GPU IDs. Device names use HCA names without port suffixes. This change primarily targets GPU-to-CPU transfers, such as receiving KV into CPU memory with HiSparse enabled on the D side. In our same-host setup, GPU-to-GPU transfers use CUDA IPC/NVLink; NIC selection does not force them through RDMA. **Shared NIC:** all four P/D rank pairs share one RDMA NIC. **Per-GPU NIC:** each P/D rank pair selects a dedicated RDMA NIC. The diagrams show a same-host setup with physical GPU IDs; configuration keys use process-visible GPU IDs. ## Accuracy Tests Validated on 8 × H200 with NIXL 1.4.1: - Cross-process GPU→GPU and GPU→pinned-CPU transfers across four GPU pairs: all 96 transfers passed full-buffer byte validation. - GLM-5.3-Flash PD smoke test with TP4/EP4 on both sides: all eight requests completed successfully. Binding logs confirmed the expected NIC mapping for all eight ranks. - CPU configuration checks and pre-commit passed. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Four concurrent GPU pairs, each transferring 64 MiB using shuffled 32 KiB pages. Median GPU→pinned-CPU transfer latency over three measured iterations after warmup: | Device selection | Pair 0 | Pair 1 | Pair 2 | Pair 3 | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | Default | 534.96 ms | 522.96 ms | 520.24 ms | 491.18 ms | | Native NIXL `device_list` | 13.05 ms | 12.87 ms | 11.42 ms | 11.83 ms | | `--disaggregation-ib-device` mapping | 12.19 ms | 12.12 ms | 12.10 ms | 12.34 ms | The CLI mapping matches native NIXL device selection performance. On this host, explicit NIC selection substantially reduced GPU→CPU transfer latency compared with the default selection. These are standalone transfer measurements, not end-to-end model throughput. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #39194339354](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39194339354) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39194339382](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39194339382) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39194339372](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39194339372)

@@ -86,6 +86,24 @@
 NIXL_ERR_SETTLE_POLL_S = 0.001
 
 
+def _resolve_ucx_device_list(ib_device: str, gpu_id: int) -> Optional[str]:
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.mooncake_transfer_engine import (
+        get_ib_devices_for_gpu,
+    )
+
+    devices = get_ib_devices_for_gpu(ib_device, gpu_id)
+    if devices is None:
+        return None
+    names = [name.strip() for name in devices.split(",")]
+    if any(not name or ":" in name for name in names):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "NIXL UCX --disaggregation-ib-device requires HCA names without "
+            "port suffixes (e.g. mlx5_0); NIXL appends port 1."
+        )
+    # NIXL's UCX device_list parser splits on the literal delimiter ", ".
+    return ", ".join(names)
+
+
 def _normalize_kv_mem_kinds(kinds: Optional[List[str]], expected_len: int) -> List[str]:

+                        "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_NIXL_BACKEND_PARAMS and "
+                        "--disaggregation-ib-device. Configure only one "
+                        "device selection or make them agree."
+                    )
+                backend_params["device_list"] = device_list
+                logger.info(
+                    "NIXL UCX device binding: gpu_id=%s, engine_rank=%s, "
+                    "device_list=%s",
+                    self.kv_args.gpu_id,
+                    self.kv_args.engine_rank,
+                    device_list,
+                )
